header.title: Billing and access
header.subtitle: Track your subscription, understand what happens next, and manage invoices without digging through Stripe.

overview.helpBody: Use this page to see whether your access is secure, when billing changes, and where to download your accounting documents.

noCustomer.description: You do not have an active plan yet. Choose a plan when you are ready to continue after the trial.
noCustomer.trialEnded: Your trial ended on {date}. A subscription is required to continue.
noCustomer.ctaHiddenHint: You will be able to subscribe as the trial gets close to ending, or from the Subscription page.
noCustomer.actionsHint: When your trial gets close to ending, keep your access active by switching to a paid plan.

subscription.closurePlanned: Cancellation scheduled. The subscription will not renew.
subscription.actionsHint: The actions below are the only ones you usually need.
subscription.noPlanHint: No active plan is protecting access right now.
subscription.activeHint: Your plan is active and your billing details are available below.
subscription.cancelAtPeriodEndHint: Your plan is still active, but it will stop automatically at the end of the current period.
subscription.closedHint: Your subscription has ended. You can still review what happened and re-subscribe if needed.
subscription.subscribeAfterTrialHint: If you subscribe during the trial, the first payment will only be charged after the remaining trial period ends.
subscription.noPlanBody: You can compare plans first, then subscribe when you are ready. Your invoices section will appear here as soon as billing starts.
subscription.activeBody: You have active access. If you need to update card details, invoices, VAT details or renewal preferences, use the actions panel on the right.
subscription.cancelAtPeriodEndBody: Your access remains active until the end of the current billing period. If you changed your mind, you can undo the scheduled cancellation.
subscription.closedBody: Your subscription is no longer active. If you want to restore access, choose a plan again and billing will resume from the new checkout.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.subtitle: Everything already issued to this Stripe customer.

feedback.canceled: Your cancellation is scheduled at the end of the current period.
feedback.missingSubscription: We couldn't find the subscription to update.
feedback.missingCustomer: Your Stripe customer account is not linked yet. Please try again in a moment.
feedback.forbiddenSubscription: This subscription does not belong to your account.
feedback.cancelFailed: We couldn't schedule the cancellation right now.
feedback.resumeFailed: We couldn't undo the cancellation right now.
feedback.portalUnavailable: The billing portal is temporarily unavailable.
feedback.invalidCustomer: Your billing account could not be found. Please contact support if this continues.
feedback.portalFailed: We couldn't open the billing portal right now.
